The folded map is independently readable; a detached teardrop pin overlaps its cleared upper center as a reusable location marker.

## Visual draft

A three panel folded map stands below a large teardrop location pin with a circular center. The pin overlaps the map's open upper middle, while fold lines continue down to its zigzag base.

## 1. Three panel folded map (solo)

A three panel map has upright fold lines and zigzag upper and lower edges. Exclude the large location pin and restore only the map subject.

## 2. Round center location pin (sub)

A teardrop marker has a rounded head, circular center, and sharp lower point. Exclude the folded map.
